releaseNotes:
Smart Life v0.12.6 (14184)
- Notes Backup remains manual-only and is now one tap from the Notes header.
- First backup connects/authorizes Google; later backups send directly to the same Gmail with no Share sheet or Send step.
- Each Gmail backup contains a readable Arabic RTL PDF plus the JSON restore file.
- The PDF uses Noto Naskh Arabic and right-to-left layout for Arabic notes.
- Existing notes, structured Work Hours data, restore behavior, and local-first storage are preserved.
